title: Wing Trailing Edge Support Structure — Oversize Bushing Repair of an Elongated Attachment Hole

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Permanent repair of an elongated attachment hole in the wing trailing edge support structure by reaming to an oversize diameter and installing an interference-fit bushing, restoring the bearing surface.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the bearing surface of an attachment hole in the wing trailing edge support structure that has become elongated under reversing load, by reaming to an oversize diameter and installing an interference-fit bushing.
sections.damage_assessment: Measure the hole ovality with the gauge set before the hole is cleaned, because cleaning removes the light bearing evidence that identifies the load direction. Record the major and minor diameters and the direction of the major axis. An ovality up to 0.30 millimetres may be repaired by this scheme. Above that, or where fretting product has reached the spar boom land, or where any crack indication is present, the repair is outside scope and an engineering assessment is required. Inspect the adjacent holes in the same pattern, because elongation is rarely confined to one hole and the repair must be applied to the whole pattern if more than one hole is affected.
sections.repair_procedure: Support the flap on the trestle set and remove the attachment bolts and the barrel nuts. Ream the affected hole to the first oversize diameter given on repair drawing RD-57-30-12-905, using the alignment jig referenced to the two adjacent holes. Do an eddy current inspection of the reamed bore and confirm that no indication remains. Measure the finished bore at three depths and confirm it is inside the tolerance band. Chill the bushing and install it with the press tool, checking the protrusion at both faces. Ream the bushing bore to the nominal bolt diameter. Apply the chromate-free surface protection to the exposed faces and apply corrosion inhibiting compound at the bushing interface. Reinstall the fitting D5730121797468 and the rib with the barrel nuts AGS934342-5A, torquing in the published sequence. Where the intercostal ARDE815539-98 was disturbed for access, refit it with new fasteners. Set the flap rigging and do the operational test.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is life limited to 20000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment. Do a repeat eddy current inspection of the bushing bore and of the surrounding land every 6000 flight cycles, together with an ovality measurement of the bushing itself. A bushing that has begun to rotate in its bore, or any crack indication at the land, invalidates the repair. Report the repair with the recorded ovality so that it is tracked against the aircraft.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Hole ovality up to 0.30 millimetres with no crack indication in the bore or in the surrounding land, and no fretting product on the rear spar boom land.

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Permanent repair of an elongated attachment hole in the wing trailing edge support structure by reaming to an oversize diameter and installing an interference-fit bushing, with the reporting that keeps the repaired population visible to later reinforcement work.

A bushing that has begun to rotate in its bore, or any crack indication at the land, invalidates the repair. Report the repair with the recorded ovality and the finished bore size so that it is tracked against the aircraft and counted in the fleet repair register; the register is what a reinforcement campaign is quoted against, and an unreported bushing turns into a stand day that nobody has costed.
